messages:
sam: Heads-up — batch model training in eu-west-1 started failing ~09:03. Jobs report high packet loss and RDMA fallbacks to TCP. A bunch of inter-node grpc calls time out.
kevin: saw the alert. p99 tokenization latency jumped. Any recent netpol changes?
maria: I merged a tightened egress policy for ml-sandbox at 08:58 (infra-ci). It was meant to lock down internet egress, but I limited namespaceSelector loosely.
sam: logs show peer errors: "connect: destination unreachable" and kernel logs show fragmented packets. MTU mismatch possible?
infra-bot: deploy:infra-ci/egress-lockdown merged by maria at 1768478800 — changed NetworkPolicy ml-sandbox/egress-default
oncall-ryan: Can someone tcpdump the pod -> pod path? Try: `kubectl debug -n ml-inference -it <pod> --image=radial/busyboxplus:curl -- /bin/sh` then `tcpdump -nn -i any host 10.40.6.12`
kevin: CNI is cilium in that cluster. The policy added an egress deny to 0.0.0.0/0 with an allow to a label that I think uses `team: sandbox` — model-serving namespaces are labelled `team: infra` so they were unintentionally excluded.
anya: That would block east-west pod traffic if the policy covers the source namespace. RDMA flows are very sensitive; once blocked you see fragmentation and retries, then TCP fallback.
maria: rolling a fast revert now (revert infra-ci/egress-lockdown). Patch command: `kubectl -n ml-sandbox apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-default
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
EOF`
kevin: temp mitigation: patch the policy to explicitly allow the model-serving namespace: `egress: - to: - namespaceSelector: matchLabels: app: model-serving` — that will restore pod->pod flows.
sam: After revert, I still see some packet drops. mtu remains 9000 on hosts but certain VFs had 1500. Could be SR-IOV VF MTU mismatch after kernel update.
oncall-ryan: check host MTU and vf settings: `ip link show | grep -E "eth|net"` and `ethtool -k <iface>`. Also check cilium bpf host interface `cilium status` and `cilium endpoint list` for policy enforcement.
maria: FYI the CI job that applied the policy also added a CiliumNetworkPolicy with a deny egress rule — I missed that. Reverting both now.
anya: After revert, run a quick job to verify RDMA: `ib_read_bw` between pods (or check `dmesg` for IB errors). Also inspect `cilium monitor` for drops caused by netpol.
kevin: Long-term: we should add a pre-deploy integration test that simulates east-west connectivity and RDMA handshake to catch namespaceSelector mislabels. Also add a dry-run mode in infra-ci for CiliumNetworkPolicy.
sam: Agreed. For now capacity hit: several GPU jobs restarted and queued; cost spikes because of retries. Please keep me posted on ETA to full recovery.
maria: rollback completed at 1768479860. Reverted both NetworkPolicy and CiliumNetworkPolicy.
oncall-ryan: I'm seeing baseline restored. No more drops in tcpdump, RDMA handshakes succeed. Pods talking again.
kevin: opened a follow-up ticket: ENGINFRA-4219 to add integration checks, and ENGINFRA-4220 to document RDMA/MTU checks in runbook.
anya: small doc snippet for runbook: `If RDMA fails: confirm MTU=9000 on host+vf, ensure netpol namespaceSelectors include model-serving labels, check cilium monitor for DENY events.`
sam: thanks all. Leave the incident channel and mark resolved once tickets are in the backlog. :thumbsup:
